svg.aria-label: The values three 8-bit formats can represent in 0–16: floats are dense near 0 and sparse far away, integers are evenly spaced
svg.text: 1 sign + 4 exponent + 3 mantissa bits: 8 values in [1, 2), and 8 in [8, 16) too
1 + 5 + 2: only 4 values per binade, wider range, sparser
An integer format with one scale: the same spacing everywhere (0.126)
Floats keep relative error fixed (~6% in E4M3), so outliers are fine; integers need a well-chosen scale
